submit_step.heading: Submit the application with both required items
submit_step.primary: Go to the fictional Submission Desk once the form is prepared and the copy route is complete. Hand in the completed application form together with the supporting copy, whichever copy route you used. Handing in only one of them is not enough.
submit_step.supplement_hidden: Use the applicable copy route where alternatives are supplied; the join requires the form and that route, not both copy alternatives.

register_step.heading: Register the fictional application before preparation
register_step.primary: Go to the fictional Registration Desk and register before you prepare the form or the supporting copy. Registration comes first. After it, the form and whichever copy route applies to you can be done independently, and both are required before you submit.
register_step.supplement_hidden: The registration, preparation and submission fees are separate stage charges; they are not three charges payable at registration.
